A container app is a site that runs one container from your own image: create one with POST /api/sites and app "container". Its hosts are the ones its routes name. Secret values (a secret variable, the registry token, the deploy token) are never in an answer: a secret shows as {secret: true, set}. A container app answers 409 to the WordPress, PHP, cache, cron, FTP, file and scan endpoints.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Manage**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/sites/:slug/app`

A container app's settings: image, routes, environment, mounts, health check, updates and recent deploys.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `AppDto; a failed deploy's logTail only from Manage up`

### `PATCH /api/sites/:slug/app`

Change what the body names; a change to how the container runs recreates it behind the health check.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{reference? (one on another registry drops the saved login), port? (on a running app it is staged in app.pending: the next start, deploy or recreate tries it (one this request queues too, or POST /api/sites/:slug/reconcile) and keeps it once the app answers there, the old one until then. It can be changed until then, or withdrawn by sending the running port; on an app that does not run it is saved at once), env?: [{name, value?, secret?}] (a secret left without a value keeps it), mounts?: [{name, path, writable?, inBackups?}], dataPaths?: [path] (the app's own; the image's VOLUMEs stay), extraHosts?: [{host, address}], hardening?: {dropAllCaps?, readOnlyRoot?, runAs?: "uid:gid"|"" (saved once its recreate has passed; app.pending until then), stopGraceSec?}, health?: {path?, host?, deployCheckPath?, timeoutSec?} (a path may end in a query, such as /health?deep=1), updates?: {mode?: "auto"|"ask"|"pinned", checkMinutes?}}`
- **Returns:** `{app: AppDto, job: JobDto|null}: 202 with the job when the container is recreated (a port alone recreates nothing); 409 for a port change while a start, restart, deploy, recreate, database password change or restore of the app is queued or running`

### `PUT /api/sites/:slug/app/routes`

Replace the app's routes; Traefik takes them at once, nothing restarts.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `{routes: [{id?, host, match?: "none"|"prefix"|"exact", path?, scheme?: "https"|"http"|"both", enabled?}]}`
- **Returns:** `AppDto; 403 below Full for a new or changed route on another site's domain; 409 while a move of the app is queued or running, for a host another server's site holds, a prefix "/" on another site's domain, dropping a host another app routes on, or plain http on a server whose Traefik is from before it`

### `PUT /api/sites/:slug/app/registry-auth`

Set or remove the login the app pulls its image with.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `{username, token} (both "" removes it)`
- **Returns:** `AppDto`

### `POST /api/sites/:slug/app/deploy`

Deploy what the reference names now, or roll back to an earlier deploy.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{deployId?: roll back to it, backupFirst?}`
- **Returns:** `job.result: {deployId, digest, imageId, gapMs} or {unchanged: true} when that image runs already, from the reference's repository`

### `POST /api/sites/:slug/app/image`

Deploy an uploaded image archive (docker save) to an app that runs uploaded images.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{uploadId, backupFirst?}`
- **Returns:** `job.result as for a deploy`

### `GET /api/sites/:slug/app/logs`

The app container's log, oldest first; poll with since for what is new.

- **Level:** Manage. A log holds whatever the app prints, secrets included
- **Input:** `?tail=500 (at most 5000)&since=<the last line's ts>`
- **Returns:** `{lines: [{ts, text}]}`

### `GET /api/sites/:slug/app/deploys`

The app's deploys, newest first.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{items: AppDeployDto[]}; a failed one's logTail only from Manage up`

### `POST /api/sites/:slug/app/deploy-token`

Make a new deploy hook token, replacing the one there was.

- **Level:** Full. A credential that outlives the key or connection that made it
- **Notes:** Destructive · Not over MCP
- **Returns:** `{token, header, url}: the token is shown this once; 409 for an app that runs an uploaded image, which has no tag to deploy`

### `DELETE /api/sites/:slug/app/deploy-token`

Switch the deploy hook off.

- **Level:** Full. The hook is set up with Full; so is taking it away
- **Notes:** Destructive · Not over MCP

### `PUT /api/app-uploads/:id`

Send one chunk of an image archive (at most 8 MiB a chunk, 8 GB a file).

Raw bytes, chunk by chunk. Pass the id to POST /api/sites (image: {uploadId}) or POST /api/sites/:slug/app/image.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Input:** `?offset=<bytes received>&size=<whole file>, body application/octet-stream`
- **Returns:** `{received, complete}; 409 {details: {received}} when the offset is not where the upload is`

### `DELETE /api/app-uploads/:id`

Throw away an image upload.

Part of the raw upload.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Not over MCP

### `PUT /api/sites/:slug/app/mount-uploads/:id`

Send one chunk of a mount's archive, a .tar.gz or .zip (at most 8 MiB a chunk, 4 GiB a file).

Raw bytes, chunk by chunk, to the app's own server.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Input:** `?offset=<bytes received>&size=<whole file>, body application/octet-stream`
- **Returns:** `{received, complete}; 409 {details: {received}} when the offset is not where the upload is`

### `DELETE /api/sites/:slug/app/mount-uploads/:id`

Throw away a mount's upload.

Part of the raw upload.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Not over MCP

### `PUT /api/sites/:slug/app/mounts/:name`

Fill a mount from an uploaded archive, replacing what it holds; the app restarts onto it.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{uploadId}`
- **Returns:** `job.result: {mount, entries}; the job fails for an archive with a link, a special file, an absolute or a .. path`

### `POST /api/hooks/app-deploy`

Deploy an app from its CI: the app's deploy token goes in X-WPL7-Deploy-Token, no body.

- **Level:** No key
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Returns:** `202 {app, outcome: "queued"|"waiting"|"noted", jobId}: "waiting" for a deploy of the tag already queued, "noted" while the app is busy; 401 for a token no app has, or an app that runs an uploaded image`
